description: Update an existing pull request with new properties, manage reviewers and work items, and add or remove tags

addReviewers.description: List of reviewer email addresses or IDs to add

addTags.description: List of tags to add to the pull request

addWorkItemIds.description: List of work item IDs to link to the pull request

additionalProperties.description: Additional properties to update on the pull request

description.description: The updated description of the pull request

isDraft.description: Whether the pull request should be marked as a draft (true) or unmarked (false)

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

pullRequestId.description: The ID of the pull request to update

removeReviewers.description: List of reviewer email addresses or IDs to remove

removeTags.description: List of tags to remove from the pull request

removeWorkItemIds.description: List of work item IDs to unlink from the pull request

repositoryId.description: The ID or name of the repository

status.description: The updated status of the pull request

title.description: The updated title of the pull request

name: update_pull_request
